description: Larva-26002 is a threat actor targeting Windows-based MS-SQL and MySQL database servers through malicious attacks involving credential brute force, dictionary attacks, and exploitation of unpatched systems. The actor deploys a Go-based scanner named ICE Cloud to access these systems using predefined credentials and Turkish language strings in their toolset.

Their focus on MS-SQL and MySQL suggests an interest in data extraction and potential disruption of operational systems.
